title: Kagurabachi
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In modern Japan, years after a war fought with enchanted swords, a sorcerer gang kills the swordsmith Kunishige Rokuhira and steals six of his blades. His son Chihiro takes up the seventh blade to recover and destroy the stolen weapons, fighting yakuza-linked criminals and sorcerers along the way.
life_message: A life of carrying a parent's legacy responsibly, protecting the vulnerable and facing the past honestly.

content.note: Frequent sword and sorcery killings, severed limbs and a mass-casualty attack (Wikipedia); AniList Gore tag 76%.
Murder of a parent, criminal auctions, wartime atrocities in backstory (Wikipedia; AniList Tragedy, Revenge tags).
No romance or sexual content noted in sources.
Some coarse language likely in gang scenes (to verify).
A character eats candy cigarettes; no real drug use noted.
Grief and survivor's guilt; a suicide in one character's backstory (Wikipedia) (to verify).
Revenge quest and armed vigilante action against criminals.
Popular Jump title with merchandise; no in-story product focus.

delivery.evidence: ANN guide reviewers note Chihiro is driven by anger, revenge the audience can understand; none call it preachy

personified.ideology: Revenge tempered by responsibility for his father's legacy

delivery.note: Revenge and responsibility are explored through Chihiro's fights rather than stated outright.

winners_losers: Chihiro and his allies who protect victims gain ground; sorcerer gangs and those who profit from weapons and human auctions lose. Sympathy goes to a code of loyalty and responsibility rather than pure vengeance.
